comments.author: CactusPie
comments.body_html:
That’s something that was generated automatically either by .NET or a library I used called NetBeauty2. I published the application as self-contained, which means that it includes .NET 6 runtime. Without it, everyone running the map would have to download and install the runtime manually. This however generates a lot of DLLs in the application folder so I used NetBeauty2 to move them automatically into the libraries folder. One of these must have generated the backup file. There is a link to the source code on GitHub - feel free to publish the app yourself and most likely the file will appear for you as well. Just make sure you publish it using release mode and self-contained option.

EDIT:

I just checked it on another PC: the file appears there as well. It’s created by NetBeauty2, if you’re curious you can read more about the library here: https://github.com/nulastudio/NetBeauty2

comments.author: CactusPie
comments.body_html: The “Follow player” option simply centers the map on your position every time it receives a position update from the game. This means the player arrow will always be at the very center of the window. If you happen to be in a map corner, it will center the view on that corner.

comments.author: Rehael_RC
comments.body_html:
OK so,

Since I started on SPT, I never created an account on the forum to comment on the hard work of the mods creators!

I’ve had an amazing experience since I have been able to mod the game.

Going from simple quality of life like a graphical and visual redesign that I didn’t like on the base game (fog in this case) to a more spicy experience with waves of bots concentrated with bosses making it more interesting to finally go through THIS mod.

It is IN-CRE-DI-BLE, the unthinkable done! I have to admit that I was using a second monitor to try and find my way around the maps with the maps provided on the Wiki, but here it’s not even a simple informative map anymore, it’s an interactive map, with the ability to track our character in real time across the entire map, even the maps that aren’t at 1: 1 ratio are fine.

You sometime need to reset the tracker to know exactly where you are but with such a tool it has become at least 6 times easier to learn a map, whether it’s to make a loot route or to learn the hot-spots, even to simply disconnect your brain after a day’s work and being to survive a chill raid without worrying about the fact that you don’t know all of your extracts initially !

It has become by far the best tool I’ve ever used to be honest it even helps me play maps I didn’t even wanted to learn on the first place such as Shoreline and this is very helpful and pleasant to use because you have the ability to even add your own maps in here which is really easy to use and with that you can also put reserve in here ! (You know that map is not available for free user on Map Genie) Very easy to use overall.

This mod is splendid, a nugget that I was waiting for a while I must say, it’s a great tool for SPT exclusive players but also for the few apprentices of the game who come to learn in OFFLINE before throwing themselves (or throwing themselves again) in the ONLINE of Tarkov.

However (And yes, we had to find things to be annoying )

Thanks again !

Would review great mods again 10/10

https://hub.sp-tarkov.com/files/file/1183-a-e-s-ultimate-questing-traders-v0-4-3/#tab_9bdfc9ae4014741cbc2383695783767ef89b08a3

Alternatively, you can try my simple update, which only fixes the missing method call, the rest is the same as in the 3.5.7 version:

https://cactuspie.com/files/BoopsQuestZoneAPI.dll

That being said, it would probably be a better idea to use A.E.S. as the author might have improved and updated the Quest API futher than I did.
